channels.body: It works only in the channels you tick. In all of them by default.
channels.name: Channels

doc.body: The gift goes onto the order at 0.00 zl. On an invoice or a receipt you choose the form: Priced in proportionally (part of the payment moves to the gift), 0.01 taken from the most expensive paid item (the total does not change), Shown as 0.00 (only when the document provider accepts a zero line), Omitted (ask your accountant) or Your own price.
doc.name: On the document

limit.body: When the whole limit is given out, the promotion pauses. Resume it with the Resume button after raising the limit.
limit.name: Piece limit

new.body: Changes apply to orders placed after saving. Orders already placed keep their gift. The date the order was placed counts.
new.name: The change does not work backwards

nostack.body: A promotion works together with another only when both agree. You have three options: stacks with all, only with selected (you tick them in the list) or with none. When a promotion that stacks with none applies, the ones below it are not checked.
nostack.name: Stacking with other promotions

order.body: OpenLinker checks promotions in the order of the list. The higher one goes first. Change it with the arrows by the number or in the menu, Move up.
order.name: Top to bottom

ownprice.body: The gift shows on the document at this price, and that amount is taken off the most expensive paid item, so the total does not change.
ownprice.name: Your own price

perclient.body: How many times the same customer can get a gift from this promotion. We recognise the customer by the buyer account and the e-mail address. On Allegro that is one buyer account (the Allegro e-mail is masked, but stable for the account). In shops it is the e-mail on the order, also for guests. The same e-mail in two channels is the same customer. If we do not know who the customer is, no gift is added and you will see "customer not known" in the history.
perclient.name: At most per customer

skip.body: If the customer already has this gift in the cart, also as a part of a set, we do not add a second one.
skip.name: Skip if the product is already in the order

stock.body: The promotion pauses itself and comes back by itself when the gift is in stock again. You do not have to do anything.
stock.name: The gift is out of stock

what.body: A promotion has a condition, which is the cart amount or a product in the order, and a benefit. For now the benefit is a gift: a product added to the order for 0.00 zl.
what.name: Condition and benefit
